content:
🚀 Exciting News! 🚀

I’m thrilled to announce that I have joined the **CDS Hooks Project Management Committee**! After working with this powerful standard since 2017, it’s an incredible honor to contribute to its future development and help move the standard forward.

If you’re already using CDS Hooks, please consider adding your implementation to the community list here:  
👉 https://github.com/cds-hooks/docs/wiki/CDS-Hooks-Availability

And if you haven’t started yet but want to explore how CDS Hooks can enhance your clinical decision support workflows, I’m available as a freelance consultant to assist with implementation.

Let’s build smarter, more interoperable healthcare together! 💡💻

#CDSHooks #HealthIT #Interoperability #HealthcareInnovation #FHIR #ClinicalDecisionSupport
